plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git workflow skills (each also a slash command): commit, commit-push, commit-push-pr, push, pr, clean_gone, cherry-pick, and merge

plugins.name: respond-to-review
plugins.description: Respond to every flagged issue on a PR — inline comments and review-body findings, including your own — dismissing false positives and fixing valid ones

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Multi-specialist code review of a PR using parallel native subagents (no agent team, no SDK)

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Audit project docs (CLAUDE.md, READMEs, docs/ trees, .claude/commands, .claude/skills, .claude/rules, architecture docs) for stale claims about the codebase and report findings with suggested fixes

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Adversarial debate on a claim. Pro and con subagents generate opening arguments then attack and defend across up to 5 rounds; orchestrator renders an inline markdown report of surviving, negated, and disputed arguments.

plugins.name: simplify
plugins.description: Simplification skills (each also a slash command): behavior-preserving code cleanups (/simplify:simplify-code) and lossless prose distillation (/simplify:simplify-prose)

plugins.name: transcript
plugins.description: Print the filepath of the current Claude Code session's .jsonl transcript

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: JIRA workflow skills (user-invoked slash commands, not model-invocable): create a structured ticket from a diff/PR/description, pick up a ticket by key to verify claims, plan, and implement it, and generate a runnable Postman QA collection from a ticket's acceptance criteria or a GitHub PR's diff.
